<!-- pr-reviewer: 5adf0114d298d92292feba1d839677d299b47b55 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review. I found no blocking defects.

- The new check refuses an unsupported 3D Pocket depth before it makes a path. The message names the tool, the band, and the Bottom of Part Z limit.
- The check uses the same shank and holder bands as verification. The verification rules do not change.
- The moved wrapper keeps its public API, error mapping, logging, and path notes.
- The tests cover shank contact, holder contact, exact contact, and tools that can reach the requested depth.

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1895`. No GitHub runner was used.

The final trial merge with upstream/main `8719d8b7a028f0c93cc78fe32ccbfdf5297a0dca` was clean. On that tree:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App unit tests and the mapped integration suites, plus `setup_align_3d` | 809 passed; 0 failed; 5 ignored; 85 test targets |
| `pocket3d_reach` | 6 passed |
| `shared_face_bodies` | 5 passed |
| `setup_align_3d` | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Before main changed, `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` passed. The quick gate also passed: 787 tests, 0 failures, 5 ignored, in 406 seconds. After the trial merge, the gate planner included the incoming main changes and selected a full batch. I stopped that run. I then ran the mapped app targets directly with `cargo test`, plus the aligned-setup suite. The table above gives those final results.

I repeated these mutations on the final trial-merged tree. Each changed only the local review copy. Each test failed with the mutation and passed after I restored the source.

| Mutation | Test in `pocket3d_reach` | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Disable the shank check | `a_closed_cavity_refuses_the_wider_shank_by_name` | RED, then GREEN |
| Disable the holder check | `a_closed_cavity_refuses_the_holder_with_a_flute_width_shank` | RED, then GREEN |
| Change `depth >= above` to `depth > above` | `a_wider_shank_touching_the_wall_top_is_refused` | RED, then GREEN |

The expected failure messages were:

```text
shank:
thread 'a_closed_cavity_refuses_the_wider_shank_by_name' (461) panicked at crates/app/tests/pocket3d_reach.rs:71:10:
the unreachable cavity must refuse before returning a path: "388 moves and 59 warnings"

holder:
thread 'a_closed_cavity_refuses_the_holder_with_a_flute_width_shank' (1231) panicked at crates/app/tests/pocket3d_reach.rs:71:10:
the unreachable cavity must refuse before returning a path: "388 moves and 122 warnings"

contact:
thread 'a_wider_shank_touching_the_wall_top_is_refused' (2001) panicked at crates/app/tests/pocket3d_reach.rs:104:10:
the wider shank touches the top at exactly the flute length: "259 moves and 11 warnings"

```

All mutation edits were restored byte for byte. No goldens moved. No UI, dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed in this PR.

The depth check is deliberately conservative. It does not use lateral room or stock removed by earlier operations. A deep cut with enough lateral room can therefore be refused. The PR records this choice and its limits. Dedicated preflight tests for a modeled holder and a drawn neck are not included. No physical machine test was run.

Requested changes: none.
